rows.title: Seaforth Island — Strutt & Parker (Aline estate)
rows.evidence: Offers over £4,000,000 for the estate as a whole. The particulars name uninhabited Seaforth Island at about 617 acres.
rows.summary: Seaforth Island lies in Loch Seaforth, between Lewis and Harris. Strutt & Parker is selling the Aline estate, and the particulars include the whole of this uninhabited island, about 617 acres and rising to 217 metres, reached from the southeast shore. A visitor filtering for islands on the market would want Seaforth because the sale takes in the island.

open_image.attribution: Rude Health / Geograph Britain and Ireland

rows.title: Harbour Island (Eilean Dà Mhèinn) — Savills
rows.evidence: Offers over £1,250,000 for about 9.7 acres. Savills status is Under offer. Closing date was 6 August 2026.
rows.reject_reason: Savills marks the listing under offer. The offer closing date was 6 August 2026, so it is not an open sale.
rows.summary: Harbour Island, Eilean Dà Mhèinn, is a private island of about 9.7 acres just off Crinan. Savills still shows a price of offers over £1,250,000, and the same page marks the sale under offer after a closing date of 6 August 2026. It is not an open listing a visitor could pursue.

rows.title: Mason Island — Matt O'Sullivan
rows.evidence: Page still says For Sale at €120,000. The page's own update stamp is 16 January 2024. About 2 acres, two ruins and the pier, not the whole island.
rows.reject_reason: No suitable open-licence photograph of the island. Commons frames that name Mason Island, Carna, show it only as a distant backdrop behind houses on the Carna shore.
rows.summary: Matt O'Sullivan still marks a holding on Mason Island, off Carna, as for sale at €120,000. The page, last updated on 16 January 2024, describes about 2 acres with two ruins and the pier. The only open photographs that name this island show the Carna shore and its houses, with Mason as a distant line on the horizon.

rows.title: Cameron Island — Lisney
rows.source_title: The Lake House, Cameron Island — Lisney
rows.evidence: Asking price €950,000. Lisney marks the house on Cameron Island, Lough Derg, for sale.
rows.reject_reason: Not in the atlas. No Cameron Island match in islands_index.json.
rows.summary: Lisney is asking €950,000 for the house on Cameron Island in Lough Derg. The particulars describe it as the only house on the island, with the rest of the island about 100 acres of woodland, and a short boat trip from a mainland quay. The name does not match any island already in the atlas.
